labels.name: clk
labels.description: Synchronous clock for the mailbox SRAM black box.

labels.name: mbox_sram_req_cs
labels.description: Chip select asserted by the mailbox FSM to start an SRAM access.

labels.name: mbox_sram_req_we
labels.description: Write-enable: 1 = write wdata to addr, 0 = read addr into resp_rdata.

labels.name: mbox_sram_req_addr
labels.description: 16-bit dword address into the mailbox payload buffer.

labels.name: mbox_sram_resp_rdata
labels.description: 32-bit read data returned by the SRAM (the read-after-write contract target).

markers.description: Phase-1 discovery — no sequencing fragment yet for mbox_sram
